title: Latency and errors per service
prompt: The on-call team wants one health row per service from `api_requests`: how many requests it got, how many failed on the server, and its median and p95 latency. Complete `solve(api_requests)`.
rules: Columns and types: `service STRING, requests BIGINT, server_errors BIGINT, p50_latency_ms INT, p95_latency_ms INT`.
`requests` counts every request. `server_errors` counts status codes from 500 to 599; 4xx codes aren't server errors.
Percentiles by nearest rank: sort the service's latencies and take the one at position `ceil(p × n)`, so p50 is a latency a request really had.
A request the client abandoned has no latency: it counts as a request but not in the percentiles. A service with no latency at all gets NULL percentiles.
hints: Group by `service` and compute all four columns in one `agg`.
`F.count(F.when(condition, 1))` counts the rows where the condition holds, and `between` includes both ends.
`F.percentile_approx` returns a value from the column, by nearest rank, and skips NULLs.
